flipToBack.prose: Flip if (you CONTROL Jakku system AND OCCUPY two Jakku battleground sites) OR (you OCCUPY Jakku system AND CONTROL two Jakku battleground sites).

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you do NOT occupy two battlegrounds (ANY battlegrounds anywhere, not just Jakku; sites and systems both count - Filters.battleground).

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back mixes CONTROL and OCCUPY explicitly in a symmetric either-way pair: (control system + occupy 2 battleground sites) OR (occupy system + control 2 battleground sites). The distinction is live: one branch only needs presence at the system, the other only needs presence at the sites.
System leaf class is Filters.Jakku_system (system itself, battleground status not required by the filter); site leaf class is Filters.Jakku_battleground_site (battleground sites on Jakku only).

Flip-back is OCCUPY (presence), count 2, over ALL battlegrounds anywhere (Filters.battleground includes battleground systems and sites) - much looser than the flip condition; keeping any two battlegrounds occupied anywhere holds the back.
No place-out-of-play condition on either side.
Back reduce-Force-loss action uses CONTROL count 2 of Filters.Jakku_battleground (no SpotOverride) - control, not occupy (Card204_032_BACK.java:80).
